rule: The shared memory roster readiness lifecycle must settle exactly once: COMMITTED with six protected vessels, or FAILED/TIMEOUT with the last verified six retained.
single_writer: Only memoryMusterCommit8612 may replace live companies[] during presentation convergence.
candidate_rule: Manifest projection and candidate construction are forbidden from mutating live companies[].
consumer_rule: Fleet Dock, Fleet Intelligence, Fleet Health, Command Deck, and Proving Ground consume a rejection-safe bounded shared promise.
fail_safe: On failure/timeout retain the last verified six-company roster and render a named diagnostic hold.
late_completion_guard: Every candidate build carries a run token. A timed-out or superseded run is invalidated and cannot later commit to live companies[].
